annotations.title: The keys our reports are signed with

description: The public keys ASPERN signs its due-diligence reports with, and how to check a signature yourself. Each key with kid, algorithm (Ed25519), the raw public key, its SHA-256 fingerprint, purposes (evidence manifest, PDF attestation), status, validity window and any revocation; the history of every key event (created, purpose added, rotated, retired, revoked); the reports withdrawn or superseded; the exact signed-bytes rule (canonical JSON, keys sorted by UTF-16 code units); the rotation, revocation and superseding policy; the offline verifier and its test vectors. What a valid signature proves and what it does not: integrity of the exact bytes under that key, never that the figures are true, complete or current. Free; no key needed.
name: evidence_keys

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

history.description: Every key event in order: at, kid, event, says.

keyPolicy.description: Rotation, revocation and the trust anchor.

keys.description: kid, algorithm, alg, x (raw public key, base64url), fingerprintSha256, purposes, status active | retired | revoked, validFrom, validTo, revokedAt, revocationReason.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

revocations.description: Reports withdrawn or superseded: dataDigest, at, kind, reason, supersededBy.

rotationStatus.description: Whether any key was ever rotated or revoked, in one sentence.

signedBytes.description: The canonicalisation rule: exactly which bytes each signature covers.

testVectors.description: The published test vectors the verifier runs offline.

verifier.description: The offline verifier script (Node 18, no dependencies).

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
